changes_made.explanation: Normalized task name by removing duplicate 'Other:query generation'. Normalized dataset names to standard forms (MS MARCO, TREC-DL). Normalized model names with consistent hyphenation. Added MS MARCO and TREC-DL as they were mentioned in experiments.

Changed answer from No to Yes because the paper explicitly uses automatic metrics (NDCG@10, MRR@10, Recall@100, Recall@1K) to evaluate retrieval performance. These are standard IR evaluation metrics used to assess the quality of the retrieval system.
No LLM-as-judge evaluation is conducted. LLMs are only used for query generation, not for evaluating the outputs.
No human evaluation is conducted or mentioned in the paper.

overall_notes: This paper focuses on information retrieval through query generation, not traditional NLG evaluation. The NLG aspect is limited to generating potential queries as part of the retrieval framework. The main contributions are in dense retrieval methodology rather than NLG evaluation per se.
